runtime-manager payload must contain a JSON list under 'bindings' and every item must be a dict with valid status in {active, pending_pause, paused, retired, failed}; malformed payloads raise RegistryOwnerUnavailableError (503)

Every current binding matching strategy_id or any Registry entry of strategy_id must reference a caller-visible approved RegistryEntry with exact artifact_version, strategy_id, and tenant linkage; bindings to draft/candidate/retired/invisible/dangling entries raise RegistryOwnerUnavailableError (503)

Every current binding for strategy_id must carry non-empty plan_id and capital_pool_id, and resolve a canonical DeploymentPlan in status {approved, executing, executed} with matching plan_id, strategy_id, capital_pool_id, artifact_id, artifact_version, tenant_id,target_stage == deployment_mode, and binding_id (required when plan.status == 'executed')

Multiple current (active/pending_pause/paused) bindings for the same capital_pool_id (unless single_runtime_enforced is False) raise RegistryOwnerUnavailableError (503); across distinct valid pools, selection orders by newest transition timestamp first and status_rank only on exact timestamp ties
